verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for an iPhone agent app, so the axis applies. The evidence never mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or an opt-out control. On-device run storage, Keychain key storage, and support for self-hosted endpoints are adjacent privacy traits, not a documented telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
